units: Targ. Ps. LX, 10 (ed. Wil. מְסָנַי pl.); a. e.—
<cite ref="Gittin 56a:12">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה שליפא מ׳</he> she happened to be barefooted.
<cite ref="Gittin 56b:3">Ib. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה סיים חד מ׳</he> (not <he>מסאני</he>) he had put on one shoe.
Gen. R. s. 41, beg.; s. 52, end, v. טוֹלְמִיסִין; a. e.—Pl. מְסָאנֵי.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:31">Lam. R. to I, 5</cite> <he>תרין מְסָאנַי</he> both my shoes.
<cite ref="Taanit 22a:4">Taan. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ אוכמי</he> black shoes (worn by gentiles).—Contr. <cite ref="M01973"><he>מְסַן</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01973"><he>מְסָנָא</he></cite>, q. v.
